name: session-ap-base
about: Phase A base of the attended wifi-bench-session: golden boot + six-message-ready core (ctx_create type 1 + txq_sync72) on the wifi-ap-start provider module (770,304 B sha256 11511980...). The AP start itself is the separate device-side stage (device/ap-fire.sh): iw phy phy0 interface add wlan0 type __ap -> ip link up -> iw dev wlan0 scan freq 2412 (mode-1 VAP base: vap_add g0 id1 48 B + vap_start g0 id1 40 B + scan_req) -> hostapd -B -i wlan0 hostapd-open.conf -> 4 AP-start frames (ap_ssid/ap_auth/ap_cfg/ap_vap_start) + firmware readback. PASS needs the AP-stage gates; this base only brings up the ACTIVE core.

steps.name: note-base
steps.about: Phase A base: PD4 golden boot -> strict ready pair -> cfg80211 wiphy registered (bench_session cfg80211 preamble) -> ONE ctx_create type 1 -> ONE txq_sync72 so the core is ACTIVE. This sequence deliberately creates NO VAP and fires NO AP frame: the AP-start stage is device/ap-fire.sh (iface type __ap, mode-1 VAP base via a one-channel scan, hostapd NEW_BEACON trigger, firmware readback pack), run by the host driver after this session returns PASS. ap_start_mode=0 = g0 id1 static keys 0x0005/0x006D/0x0127/0x0065.

steps.name: cfg-status
steps.about: wiphy registered after the ready handshake (the cfg80211 preamble already waits for /sys/class/ieee80211; this is the sequence-local re-gate)

steps.name: pre-pack
steps.about: pre-create state on this fresh boot: no context (ctx4+0x190 = 0), exception mask 0, exception staging word 0

steps.name: ctx-create-t1
steps.about: prerequisite 1/2: ONE context-create H2D (g0 id1 key 0x64, data[0]=type 1) - the 2026-11-26 mode-1 bench ladder had this consumed in 0 polls before the scan

steps.name: post-create
steps.about: the create allocated the measured ctx4 body (same PACK as C2: ctx4[0]=4, ctx4+0x10=0x00010001, ctx4+0x434=0x0100478C)

steps.name: txq-sync72
steps.about: prerequisite 2/2: ONE TXQ config sync H2D (g0 id1 cmd 0xd8, 72-byte node) -> the core is ACTIVE before the provider VAP/scan sequence (vap_start_first=1)

steps.name: post-txq
steps.about: the TXQ handler ran clean: exception mask and staging word stay 0

steps.name: h2d-status
steps.about: the two base H2D frames (ctx_create type 1 + txq_sync72) were consumed; no refusal/timeout

steps.name: ap-pre-pack
steps.about: hostapd-stage pre-health (the device-side stage re-reads these before its first write): PD4 page, boot state, exception mask/staging, mailbox out0/out2 all clean

steps.name: note-end
steps.about: Base PASS = core ACTIVE + clean packs. The host driver then runs device/ap-fire.sh (hostapd stage) and device/ap-readback.sh; phase A PASS requires the AP-stage gates (4 frames posted+consumed, no refusal, mask/staging 0, page/state golden, VAP readback evidence). Any STOP -> power-cycle, analyse offline, never re-send a frame in the same boot.
